title: Lowest Common Ancestor of a Binary Tree III

examples.explanation: The LCA of nodes 5 and 1 is 3.
The LCA of nodes 5 and 4 is 5 since a node can be a descendant of itself according to the LCA definition.

constraints: The number of nodes in the tree is in the range [2, 10^5].
p and q exist in the tree.
hints: Analyze the key properties of Lowest Common Ancestor of a Binary Tree III.
Formulate an optimal space-time trade-off approach.
